subject: planner: optimize return type of partial sum for tiflash (#59709)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent. Changes are confined to planner/expression type inference for AVG→(COUNT,SUM) rewrites in MPP/cop pushdown: `TypeInfer4AvgSum` now uses regular SUM type inference for simple column arguments (smaller intermediate DECIMAL), while keeping the previous wider return type for non-column arguments (e.g. scalar expressions like division) to preserve MySQL/TiFlash compatibility; planner call sites were updated to pass eval context and handle the (expected-never) error path; unit coverage added. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/compatibility within the touched codepaths.
